summary: Patch the supported compilers and OpenAPI parser dependencies
details: Advance source builds to minimum Go 1.26.11 and current Go 1.27.4 for GO-2026-6859, with matching immutable compiler images, CI selections and an independent security-floor regression for both supported lines.
Upgrade kin-openapi to 0.149.0 and its required YAML and JSON Schema dependencies for called advisories GO-2026-6795, GO-2026-6789 and GO-2026-6785.

Retain existing OpenAPI projection, JSON/YAML, duplicate-key, external-reference and payload-binding checks across ingestion and replay. Refresh native Go source references after comparing all sixteen reviewed files against the verified compiler archives.
Keep build-input drift mutations tied to the declared compiler selections while retaining all rejection cases and the earlier certificate-verification security floor.

compatibility.notes: New source builds require the updated supported Go patches. Routes, wire schemas and evidence formats retain their existing contracts; malformed-document handling receives the upstream fixes. Historical release artifacts and validation records retain their original compiler and dependency identities.

security: Apply upstream fixes for the four called production-gate findings without advisory suppression or policy exceptions. Preserve tenant authorization, bounded parsing, immutable evidence and separate migration coordination.
limitations: Existing unrelated advisories retain their separate triage and final-image review.
Full production qualification remains required before EVY-1206 is complete.
